card.name: Closing and covering words after containers
card.fires_on: Words about closing, covering or delivering, such as "closure", "closing" or "covered", most often right after "vial", "syringe" or "bottle" in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Vial closure
modes.description: The word "closure" or "closing" after a vial or syringe in handling instructions.
modes.example: Stability and Storage Penetrate vial<< closure>> only one time with a suitable sterile transfer

modes.label: Other verbs after a container noun
modes.description: A verb such as "delivers" right after "bottle" in a product description.
modes.example: Each bottle<< delivers>> 300 mg of tovor

modes.label: Scattered non-medical words
modes.description: Mid-word or plain words in general text, such as "covered", "atches" or "lunches".
modes.example: the cloth that<< covered>> the head of St. John the Baptist
